- Description: Raised by PM in shift 5 (2026-11-18T16:33Z) after correcting FOUR wrong card descriptions in one shift.

THE GAP: `project_manager action='update_task'` rejects a `description` argument ("Nothing to update: provide at least one of status, board, column, sprints, sprint, priority, due_date, wake_at, progress, assignees or tags"). A task's description/body is writable only ONCE, at `create_task`. After that there is no supported way to correct it, so a wrong body persists forever at the top of the card while corrections pile up in the comment thread below it.

WHY IT MATTERS (real occurrences this shift, all in the efforts increment):
- `a0f362ed` body says "Expect 8 `ok -` lines" and `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`; truth is 9 cases and `node --test tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`. The body cannot be fixed. Owner reads the body first.
- `675c4695` body said "reword" the HTML comment; the correct action is DELETE it (a reworded comment is still an added comment and can be re-flagged). Settled only by a comment, so the body still contradicts it.
- `91411767` body listed "add the test script" as step 1; `package.json:14` already had it.
- `0bc8b144` body says "3 files + 1 hunk"; the measured scope is 4 paths with the fix under `global_settings/`, not `kanban/`.
- `a0f362ed` also carried a wake_at (11-20 14:00Z) later than the commit it gates (11-19 13:00Z) — that one WAS fixable, because wake_at is mutable.

MODES OF FAILURE: (a) owner follows the body and does the wrong thing; (b) owner "passes" a card without doing the work because the body described work already done; (c) a contradiction between body and comment is resolved inconsistently by whoever arrives first.

OPTIONS:
1. Support `description` on `update_task` (rewrite the body; prefer appending a `## PM amendment` block so history is not destroyed).
2. Keep bodies immutable but add an explicit `superseded_by` / `authoritative_comment_id` pointer rendered above the body.
3. Minimum viable: render a visible banner on the card when comments exist and the body is older than the last comment — "body may be stale, read the latest comment".

RECOMMENDATION: option 1 with append semantics (option 3 as a cheap interim). Anything that leaves the owner reading a known-wrong instruction costs more than it saves.

ACCEPTANCE: a PM can correct a wrong task body through the task tools, and the correction is visible at the top of the card without reading the comment thread.

This card does NOT block the efforts increment. It is a process/tooling defect in the kanban layer, not in the product.

## Increment: localised the immutability — it is client-side by omission, the plumbing already accepts `description`

**Changed files: none.** This card is a tooling/process defect; the increment below is localisation evidence for whoever owns the fix. No code written, no diff to attribute.

### The premise is confirmed at the tool layer
`project_manager update_task` accepts `status`, `board`, `column`, `sprints`, `priority`, `due_date`, `progress`, `assignees`, `tags`, `wake_at`, `schedule`, `schedule_context` — **no `description`**. `create_task` requires `description`. So a description is writable exactly once, at creation, and afterwards only a comment can correct it. The owner of the card therefore keeps reading the stale text, because the stale text *is* the card.

### New finding: the client does not "enforce" immutability, it simply never offers the field
Traced the full write path in this tree (`client/`):

| Anchor | What it proves |
|---|---|
| `src/store/chats.js:1151-1161` | `updateChatInfo({chat, updates})` → `project.$api.chats.updateMetadata(chat.id, updates)` then `Object.assign(state.chats[chat.id], updates)`. `updates` is **passed through generically — no whitelist**. |
| `src/api/modules/chats.js:81-83` | `updateMetadata(chatId, metadata)` → `POST /api/chats/metadata` with `{chat_id, metadata}`. |
| `src/components/kanban/NewTaskDialog.vue:119-128` | the create dialog builds `updates` from `project_id`, `users`, `deadline`, `estimation_cost`, `file_list` — **`description` is never sent**. |
| `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` | **0 matches for `description`** (631 lines): the only task-edit surface does not expose it. |
| `src/components/kanban/TaskCard.vue:69-75` | the card renders the description read-only behind a `▼ more` toggle — display only, no edit affordance. |

Consequence: the fix is **two small UI edits**, not a new endpoint — `description` added to the `updates` object in `NewTaskDialog.vue` and a description field in `TaskSettings.vue` will already flow through `updateChatInfo` → `updateMetadata` unchanged.

### Open question this increment cannot close (boundary, not a guess)
Whether `POST /api/chats/metadata` treats `description` as first-class chat metadata or nests it inside a `metadata` blob is **backend behaviour** (`api/`, outside this tool root — paths outside `.../codx-junior-platform/client` are rejected). If it nests, `Object.assign` in `chats.js:1160` would write the value to the wrong level and the card would still read stale. **The backend owner must confirm the persistence shape before the UI fix is shipped**, and the `update_task` tool needs a `description` parameter for agents.

### Validation evidence
**None executable.** No shell and no node in this runtime, so no test command can be produced (`91411767` tracks exactly that). Checked: `README/build` scripts exist, but nothing can run here. I am **not** claiming a pass.

### Follow-up
Backend confirmation of the metadata shape is owned by `675c4695` territory and the `api/`-rooted agent; I am not reopening a known dead end. Card left open for review.

### Addendum — the one place a naive UI fix will silently no-op

Field name confirmed empirically: the task document has a **top-level** `description` (it is returned by `get_task`/`update_task` in the chat payload), and `TaskCard.vue:69-75` reads it directly.

But the write path wraps it:

- client: `updateMetadata(chatId, metadata)` → `POST /api/chats/metadata` body `{ chat_id, metadata: {...updates} }` (`src/api/modules/chats.js:81-83`)
- store: `Object.assign(state.chats[chat.id], updates)` — applies **flat** to the local chat object (`src/store/chats.js:1160`)

So the client will optimistically show the new description *even if the server stores it nested under `metadata`*. That is a false green: the card fixes itself on screen, reverts on reload, and the next agent reads the stale body again — the exact failure this card is about.

**Requirement for whoever fixes this:** before or with the UI change, assert on the server that `POST /api/chats/metadata` with `{"description": "..."}` changes the document's top-level `description` (reload and read it back). If it does not, the fix needs the backend to spread `metadata` onto the chat document (or a dedicated `description` field), and only then the two UI edits in the parent comment.

Acceptance remains unchanged: the owner sees the corrected text at the top of the card without reading the comments.

## Symptom
Global Settings → Efforts → "Delete this effort" always reports an error even when the server deleted the effort. The list is not reloaded, so the deleted effort stays on screen until the panel is reopened.

- `client/src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue:358-372` (`remove()`): `this.assertOk(await api.delete(this.draft.name))`.

It mirrors the pre-existing convention of `client/src/api/api.js:900-902` (`profiles.delete`, same `async … await` swallow), so the module is the consistent side and the component is the outlier.
